items.exampleEn: Their new residence is on the tenth floor of a quiet building.
items.exampleZh: 他們的新住所在一棟安靜大樓的十樓。

items.exampleEn: Rental prices near the university are very high.
items.exampleZh: 大學附近的租金非常高。

items.exampleEn: The lease does not allow pets in the apartment.
items.exampleZh: 租約規定公寓裡不能養寵物。

items.exampleEn: The plumber fixed the shower in twenty minutes.
items.exampleZh: 水電工二十分鐘就修好了淋浴設備。

items.exampleEn: They are building a house on a plot near the lake.
items.exampleZh: 他們正在湖邊的一塊地上蓋房子。

items.exampleEn: Only the very rich can afford a mansion in this area.
items.exampleZh: 只有非常有錢的人才買得起這一區的豪宅。

items.sentenceEn: The plumber charged us fifty dollars just to come to the house.
items.sentenceZh: 水電工光是上門就收了我們五十元。

items.audioEn: Our lease ends in March, so we need to find a new apartment soon.
items.audioZh: 我們的租約三月到期，所以得盡快找新公寓。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼得盡快找新公寓？
options: The rent will go up in March

items.sentenceEn: Each plot in this new area is about the size of a tennis court.
items.sentenceZh: 這個新區的每一塊地大約是一個網球場的大小。

items.sentenceEn: Car rental is cheaper if you book it a week ahead.
items.sentenceZh: 提前一週預訂，租車會比較便宜。

items.stemEn: The famous singer lives in a huge ____ with twelve bedrooms and a pool.
items.stemZh: 那位知名歌手住在一棟有十二間臥室和游泳池的大豪宅裡。

items.stemEn: The writer's former ____ is now a small museum about his life.
items.stemZh: 那位作家的故居現在是一間介紹他生平的小博物館。

items.passageEn: When Jason moved to the city for work, he could not afford to buy a home, so he looked for a rental. He found a small apartment next to an outpatient clinic and signed a one-year lease. The building was once a rich family's mansion, and it still has beautiful old windows. However, the pipes are very old, and Jason has called the plumber three times this year. Behind the building, there is a small plot of land where people who live there can grow vegetables, and Jason enjoys gardening after work. Although he likes the apartment, he hopes his next residence will be a little closer to his office.
items.passageZh: Jason 為了工作搬到城裡時，買不起房子，所以找了出租的房子。他在一間門診診所旁邊找到一間小公寓，簽了一年的租約。這棟建築以前是一戶有錢人家的宅邸，到現在還保有漂亮的老窗戶。不過，水管非常老舊，Jason 今年已經叫了三次水電工。大樓後面有一小塊地，住戶可以在那裡種菜，Jason 下班後很喜歡在那裡種菜。雖然他喜歡這間公寓，但他希望下一個住處能離公司近一點。

questions.questionZh: 這棟公寓大樓以前是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們打算把租約再延長一年。
referenceEn: We plan to extend the lease for another year.
We are going to extend our lease for one more year.
rubricZh: 表示打算的寫法不限（例如 plan to、are going to 等）

items.promptZh: 這附近很難找到週末還願意來的水電工。
referenceEn: It is hard to find a plumber who will come on weekends around here.
Around here, it's hard to find a plumber who works on weekends.
rubricZh: 「水電工」可寫，例如 plumber 等
「很難找到」可寫，例如 it is hard to find、it's difficult to find 等
「週末還願意來的」可寫，例如 who will come on weekends、who works on weekends 等
